support_tickets.subject: Need PDF export for reports
support_tickets.description: Multiple customers have requested the ability to export reports as PDF files for sharing with stakeholders who don't have system access.

support_tickets.subject: Time tracking feature request
support_tickets.description: Customers want built-in time tracking to log hours spent on projects and tasks.

support_tickets.subject: Salesforce integration needed
support_tickets.description: Enterprise customers requesting native Salesforce integration for syncing contacts and opportunities.

support_tickets.subject: Mobile app crashes on upload
support_tickets.description: Users report the mobile app crashes when trying to upload files larger than 10MB.

support_tickets.subject: Custom report builder
support_tickets.description: Users want to create their own reports with custom fields and filters.

support_tickets.subject: Approval workflow support
support_tickets.description: Organizations need multi-level approval workflows for expenses, time off, and document reviews.

support_tickets.subject: Help setting up API integration
support_tickets.description: Customers need assistance with API setup and documentation.

support_tickets.subject: Excel export with formatting
support_tickets.description: Users want Excel exports that preserve formatting and include charts.

support_tickets.subject: HubSpot integration
support_tickets.description: Marketing teams requesting HubSpot integration for campaign tracking.

support_tickets.subject: Dashboard slow to load
support_tickets.description: Users report the main dashboard takes 10+ seconds to load with large datasets.

support_tickets.subject: Resource scheduling feature
support_tickets.description: Professional services firms need resource allocation and capacity planning.

support_tickets.subject: Billable hours tracking
support_tickets.description: Agencies need to track billable vs non-billable time per client/project.

support_tickets.subject: SSO setup assistance
support_tickets.description: Enterprise customers need help configuring SAML SSO.

support_tickets.subject: Mobile app improvements
support_tickets.description: Users want better mobile experience with offline support.

support_tickets.subject: Notification emails not sending
support_tickets.description: Some users not receiving notification emails for important updates.
